totp.title: Second factor
totp.intro: A six-digit code, on top of the password, asked at every sign-in.
totp.scan: Add this account to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
totp.recoveryHint: Write them down now: they will not be shown again. Each works once, and lets you sign in without your phone.

training.title: Training centre
training.notACenter: This farm is not a training centre. Declare it from the settings.
training.isCenter: This farm is a training centre.
training.declare: Declare this farm as a training centre
training.declareHint: A centre creates student farms by duplicating a template farm. The current farm will be the first template; you can add others.
training.templatesHint: One per cohort, module or level. The default template is the one offered when creating a student farm; it cannot be removed.
training.newHint: The template farm is copied in full: reference data, beds, plantings and tasks. The copy stands alone — the student never touches the template.
training.emailHint: Without an account, they will receive an invitation and become the farm’s owner on accepting it.
training.created: “{{nom}}” created: {{lignes}} rows copied from the template.
training.endConfirm: Trainers will lose access; the student keeps the farm and everything in it.
training.closeHint: Student farms already created are not deleted: they simply stop being attached to this centre.
training.closeBlocked: {{count}} training(s) still running: end them first.

moon.title: Lunar calendar
moon.hint: Sillon shows the state of the sky: root, leaf, flower or fruit day, waxing or waning in declination. It draws no recommendation from it and moves nothing.
moon.timezoneHint: It cuts the civil day: a wrong zone shifts the whole calendar by a day.
moon.alignHint: Each planting moves by at most three days, to a day of the type its crop calls for. Those with nowhere to go stay put.
moon.disabled: The lunar calendar is off. Turn it on in the settings.
moon.disclaimer: Sillon computes the Moon’s position from ephemerides and shows the state of the sky. It copies no published calendar and draws no recommendation from it.

day.heading: {{date}}
day.noPosition: Place the farm on the map to get rise and set times.
day.explain: How this index is worked out
day.explainBody: A hundred points, less what the lunar calendar tradition takes away: a lunar node, a perigee, an apogee, a day split between two types. It has never been measured against a yield, and is not one: controlled studies show no reproducible effect of lunar phases on plant growth. It blocks nothing and moves nothing.
day.reasonsNone: Nothing takes points off this day.
day.windowHint: Hours when the moon is above the horizon and there is daylight.
day.noWindow: The moon is not above the horizon during daylight.
day.suggestedHint: Customary jobs for a {{type}} day in {{month}}. Nothing is added to your plan.
day.farmTasksNone: No task planned that day in your plan.
day.cropsTitle: What you grow of this type
day.cropsNone: No crop in your reference list carries this harvested part. It is set on the crop.
day.disclaimer: The notes and suggested jobs are customary tasks, written for Sillon. They copy no published calendar, know nothing of your ground, and do not replace your growing plan.

map.title: Garden map
map.searchHint: The search sends the address you type to the geocoding service configured on this deployment. It only goes when you start it, never while you type.
map.clickHint: Clicking the map sets the farm’s position.
map.manualHint: Decimal degrees (WGS 84), as a GPS or a map gives them. Five decimals is enough: about one metre.
map.notSetYet: The farm’s position has not been set yet.
map.notSetByOwner: The farm’s owner has not set the position yet.
map.drawHint: Pick a location, then trace its outline with the polygon tool at the top right of the map. A new outline replaces the previous one.
map.targetNone: — none; clicking sets the farm’s position —
map.measured: “{{nom}}”: {{surface}} m², longest side {{longueur}} m. The bed length you entered was not changed.
map.measureApplied: Bed length updated. Seed and order calculations now use it.
map.rotateHint: A positive angle turns clockwise. The whole layout rotates around its common centre: beds keep their relative positions and paths.

references.noBedWidth: Published figures exist for this crop, but they are per square metre: set the farm bed width so they can be offered here.
references.disclaimer: These figures come from published, cited work. They know nothing of your soil or your climate: your own records replace them as soon as they exist.
